title: UK culture
descriptionFa: جشن‌ها و روزهای خاص، غذای سنتی، انواع مدرسه، و سیاست در بریتانیا.

words.example: Nowruz is the biggest festival in Iran.
Armenians in Iran celebrate Christmas on the sixth of January.
They put the presents under the Christmas tree.
In London, people watch the fireworks on New Year's Eve.
He bought her red roses on Valentine's Day.
Children get chocolate eggs at Easter.
Children wear scary costumes on Halloween.
Monday is a bank holiday, so we don't have to work.
I got a lovely present for my birthday.
We decorate the haft-sin table before Nowruz.
On Chaharshanbe Suri, people jump over a bonfire.
The fireworks over the river were beautiful.
On Sundays, many British families eat roast beef.
words.tipFa: roast potatoes = سیب‌زمینی تنوری. غذای سنتی یکشنبه‌ها: Sunday roast.

words.example: Put the chicken in the oven for an hour.
My son goes to nursery school three mornings a week.
words.tipFa: برای ۲ تا ۴ سال. kindergarten هم می‌گن.

words.example: Children in Iran go to primary school for six years.
My daughter starts secondary school next September.
Most children in the UK go to a state school.
My cousin goes to an expensive private school.
Millions of people watched the royal family on TV.
Cyrus was a great Persian king.
Elizabeth II was queen of the UK for seventy years.
The British Prime Minister lives at 10 Downing Street.
The parliament makes new laws for the country.
words.tipFa: ساختمان پارلمان بریتانیا: the Houses of Parliament.
